one_line: Lay out every piece first, show hands building one item, then a child holding the result, all in 21 s.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down view of a wooden table covered with colourful flower-craft pieces, a toddler's hand at the edge. Voiceover (transcript) and subtitle: "מצאתי לכן את ערכת היצירה המושלמת הזאת מעלי אקספרס" (0:00-0:03).
q1_hook.why: The kit is on screen at once and the first line says what it is and where it is from (H1, H2), spoken and subtitled together (H6). "I found it for you" is a recommendation, not a question or a result to wait for (H5).

beats.what: Top-down spread of all pieces, a toddler's hand at the edge; "מצאתי לכן את ערכת היצירה המושלמת"
beats.why: Shows what is in the kit and names it

beats.what: Close-up of adult hands pressing flower heads onto stems with a purple press; finished flowers behind
beats.why: The one making step, 9 s, the longest hold

beats.what: A child's hand places a blue stem in the pot; "העסיק אותה שעות בכיף"
beats.why: A child is shown using it, then the claim

beats.what: A girl about 3 holds the finished bouquet in the pot and smells it
Everything packed in a clear zip bag; "ובסוף, הכל נכנס לתוך שק אחסון שקוף ונוח"
beats.why: A practical benefit as the closing beat

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "להגיב כאן ״פרח״" to get the links, plus following the page. Nothing in the video asks for a comment, and nothing names a person to send it to.
q2_flow.why: At 21 s with a new view every 1 to 9 s there is no dead air (R1, R2). Product facts sit inside a hands-on demo and a child's moment (R3). The warmest beat, the girl with the bouquet at 0:14, comes before the end, and the Reel closes on a storage bag (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: "מי שרוצה את הלינקים: 1.לעקוב אחרי העמוד 2.להגיב כאן ״פרח״", then "ואני שולחת לכן מיד הכל + קישור לקהילה הכי שווה לאימהות".
q3_cta.why: A generic comment word that delivers links is a workable funnel (C3), but it appears only in the caption, below "more", so the video gives no hint a link exists (C6). Follow plus comment plus a community link is several actions, and the follow is a gate (C1, C2).

q4_shown.what: All kit pieces on a table 0:00; adult hands pressing flowers with the press 0:02-0:10; a child's hand placing a stem 0:11; a girl about 3 holding the finished bouquet 0:14; the full bouquet 0:17; the kit in a zip bag 0:18. No price.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen from 0:00 and handled by 0:03 (S1), and hands alone carry the making step (S4). The child's reaction is brief, so "busy for hours" is only a claim (S6, K8). No price or age range is given, only the shop name (S3).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 20.9 s, about 3.5 s each, straight cuts; the longest is 8.8 s (the press demo). No speed changes. Subtitles in one or two lines, phrase by phrase, synced to the voiceover. Ends on the bag shot, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Movement from frame one (E1) and a cut every 2 to 4 s, with one longer hold, keep the pace moderate (E2). Voice with synced subtitles works muted (E4). It ends right after the last benefit, with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A craft kit found on AliExpress: children build a flower bouquet from stems and petals, and it packs into a bag. A parent's find, for parents who want kids busy.
q6_topic.why: Keeping a child busy and creative is a real parenting concern (K6), and a practical find told with a child moment suits parents (K4). A friend who needs a quiet activity is a natural person to send it to (R5), but the Reel never asks.

q7_filmed.what: Top-down static shot of a wooden table; high-angle static close-up of hands at the press; handheld top-down on a child's hand; static eye-level medium of a girl by a sofa in daylight; handheld tilting bag shot.
q7_filmed.why: A home table and daylight look native (H8, F7), and top-down hands show the viewer the step as they would do it (F5), filling the frame (F4). Subtitles run over the lower part of the picture (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a dark edge, one or two lines, centred about 74% down, phrase by phrase: "מצאתי לכן את ערכת היצירה המושלמת הזאת מעלי אקספרס" (0:00), "הילדים מרכיבים לבד זר פרחים שלם" (0:04), "העסיק אותה שעות בכיף" (0:12), "וליצור כל פעם זר אחר" (0:15), "ובסוף, הכל נכנס לתוך שק אחסון שקוף ונוח" (0:17). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "ערכת יצירה מושלמת לילדים מעלי אקספרס 🌸". About 55 words: product description, benefits, a two-step ask with a DM promise and a community link. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: Full-sentence subtitles carry the voice muted (T1) but are near-verbatim and sit over the demo (T2), in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption's first line names the item and shop in search words, but has no hashtags (T7), no disclosure of any link arrangement (T8).

weak_points: The ask is only in the caption, hidden below "more"; follow gate; low-resolution file; subtitles over the demo; no price or age range; no disclosure; "busy for hours" is only said.
lumebook_takeaway: Spread the book's parts top-down on a table in frame one, show hands paging to the name page, and put the one comment word on screen in the last seconds.
not_verified: Price and listing. Whether the link earns the creator a commission. Whether 360 x 640 is the original size or a download size. The girl's age (about 3 is an estimate). Music is not evident. Corrections to src/coded: cta_type lists link_in_bio, but the caption has no bio link, it promises a DM with links and a community link; there is no CTA text in the video; no adult face appears, only hands.
